paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Avina, Shabbat 60b; Rabbi Elazar bar Avina, Berakhot 4b; Rabbi Yaakov bar Avina, Shevuot, chapter 6, halakhah 3; Shila bar Avina, Avodah Zarah 22b; Rav Tachlifa bar Avina, Chullin 60b.

notes.text: The consulted Avodah Zarah 22b distinguishes Rav Tachlifa from Rav Shela, through whom he reports. Hyman’s Shila has no title in this occurrence.
